# VoiceAct Solutions
> Web & mobile apps, engineered to ship. Senior software development studio building production-grade web applications, mobile products, AI integrations, and custom CRMs for startups and growing businesses.

## Overview
VoiceAct Solutions (https://voiceact.tech) is a full-stack digital product engineering studio based in Bengaluru, India. We partner with founders, venture-backed startups, and scale-ups to design, architect, build, and scale high-performance software products.

## Core Services
- **Custom Web Application Development**: High-scale frontend & backend systems using Next.js, React, Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Custom CRM & ERP Systems**: Tailored business workflow automation, lead management, pipeline tracking, and internal tooling designed to replace expensive COTS subscriptions.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native and Flutter.
- **AI Solutions & Integrations**: LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, automated workflow engines, and smart AI features.
- **SaaS Architecture & Cloud Infrastructure**: Scalable cloud infrastructure, PostgreSQL databases, Docker containerization, and AWS/Cloudflare deployments.
- **Dedicated Engineering Teams & Staff Augmentation**: Hire dedicated React, Next.js, and Full-Stack engineers on flexible monthly retainer models.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Radix UI.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Fastify, Express, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, PlanetScale, Prisma, Drizzle ORM.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, CI/CD GitHub Actions.
